name: Ivana Horvat
bio:
Ivana's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. After years in retail management, a chance encounter with a local racing team sparked a passion she never knew she possessed. She quickly immersed herself in the world of racing, volunteering at events and learning the intricacies of motorsport marketing. Now, as a Marketing Coordinator, she brings a fresh perspective and a relentless dedication to detail.

Her approach is deeply rooted in meticulous planning and execution. Ivana believes that even the smallest details can make a significant impact on a campaign's success. While new to the professional motorsport scene, her determination to learn and her commitment to quality make her a valuable asset. She is eager to apply her organizational skills and passion for the sport to elevate the team's marketing efforts.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, neatly styled with a slight wave and subtle highlights framing her face.
physical.description: Ivana is a woman of average height with a warm, friendly smile and a composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously detailed notes and ideas.
Insists on using a specific brand of pen for all her work, claiming it improves her focus.
Has a habit of organizing her workspace multiple times a day to ensure maximum efficiency.
